issues.description: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat constructor still accepts numMergeWorkers/mergeExec but silently discards them
issues.detail: The constructor signature still takes numMergeWorkers and ExecutorService mergeExec, validates them, but no longer stores them. Even if a user only intends to read, code paths that construct the format via reflection or SPI with these parameters get no error, and the unused parameter validation is now misleading. Since fieldsWriter throws UOE anyway, these parameters should be removed or the constructors collapsed to read-only.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields downgraded from protected to package-private breaking subclasses
issues.detail: Fields like dimension, size, scalarQuantizer, slice, etc. were changed from protected to package-private. The class is still public abstract, so any external subclass that extended OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues outside this package will fail to compile. Even within backward-codecs this is a binary-incompatible change to a public API surface.

issues.description: Public NAME constant downgraded to package-private may break existing consumers
issues.detail: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME and Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME were public static final String. Downstream code (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, custom codecs) may reference these constants by name to detect or filter formats. Demoting to package-private is a source/binary break for callers that haven't yet adapted to the move.

issues.description: Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsReader visibility reduced from public to package-private
issues.detail: The reader was `public final class` and now is `final class`. External callers that constructed or referenced this reader directly (e.g. to wrap quantized readers) will break. Since this is a backward-compat module specifically meant for reading old segments, reducing visibility makes it harder for downstream codecs to interoperate with old data.

Both Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat and Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat had @Deprecated annotations removed in the move. Since the PR description explicitly calls these legacy formats replaced by Lucene104, the deprecation signal should remain so users get IDE/compiler warnings when constructing them. Removing it weakens the migration path.

issues.description: CHANGES.txt entry has inconsistent indentation on the continuation line
issues.detail: The new bullet has `   (Trevor McCulloch)` indented three spaces vs the typical two-space continuation used elsewhere in the file. Minor but worth normalizing for consistency.

review.summary: This PR moves the legacy Lucene99 scalar-quantized vector formats from core to backward-codecs and disables writing via UnsupportedOperationException. The mechanical move is mostly clean, but several API-visibility downgrades (public NAME, protected fields in OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues, public reader class) could break downstream consumers like Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. The deprecation annotations should remain on the legacy classes, and the dead numMergeWorkers/mergeExec parameters on the read-only format should be cleaned up. Test scaffolding for V0/V1 writers looks reasonable.
